name: oder-of-submittals
description: The submittal register worked back from the date material is needed on site: submittals not yet submitted past their latest submit date (required on site less lead time and review time), reviews running over the allowed days, revise-and-resubmit not resubmitted, third and later revisions, approvals that came after the order-by date, and spec sections with no submittal. Ages ball-in-court. Drafts reminders. Never approves or changes a submittal.
